GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went back Settled Down last 10len Hooked Out 600m Wide made ground last 200m # good effort/back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was eased back to a position with cover at the rear of the field. Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Quickly Crossed Clear 3rd, 2.5 Lengths @ 600m. fanned 3 Wide Straightening Up all Clear . Ridden Along Joined Lead 175m. Finished Too Well from there # sat 3rd/sound win
Jumped Ok drifted back 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start, was buffeted between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away OK. Not pushed early & raced 2nd last Two Wide (7L from lead). Held Ground until improving 3 Wide @ 500m & pushed to chase Four Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & worked home soundly in last 150m. # Gave too much start
Just Off Mid-Field 4.5l home turn 4l Good Run Through Inside Battled On Well gave winner 6kg Never Stopped Trying # game 63kg
Jumped Fast on-pace oppo Not Bustled Settled Down 4th Inside 3 Lengths same to straightening up clear run home within 1 Lengths x 200 Soon After flat (t/t/off) # just kept 3rd
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn hooking very wide. ran on well # covered ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After being loaded into the barriers, became fractious and lunged forward. Was examined by the Veterinary Officer and cleared to start. Began awkwardly. Near the 800m was checked when forced in across heels. After this incident, got its head up and raced keenly for some distance. On the first turn near the 700m was severely hampered when forced wide by another runner. Blundered in the going near the 500m when racing very wide.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled from Outside Settled Down rear Four Wide with a trail 7 Lengths , Clear All The Way asked to go at the 400m Just Held Ground - # 4 wide, 1-paced
(cross-over nose band off) Jumped Well , Settled Down 3 Wide 8th 4.5 Lengths @ 600m. Mid Field Straightening Up Limited room final 150m, on heels of trifecta # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported passing the 200m he positioned his mount in anticipation of improving into a developing run, however when this run failed to materialise, he became held up. He stated his mount was unable to be shifted wider, due to another runner racing in close proximity to his outside and, as a result, it was untested for the remainder of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong making good ground, closest on the line # back/ran on well
Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a half length, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up then Dropped Out in Straight # weakaned badly
